title: Crown Network
description: Crown Network is a Minecraft network by content creator LStream6.
body:
### Crown Network Servers
Crown Network is a Minecraft network by content creator [diCaprio](https://youtube.com/@turtlesmp21).

On Crown Network you'll find these servers:

- **New:** Pancake Craft
- **New:** Heroes SMP
- Ultima SMP
- Llama SMP
- Power SMP
- Minigames
- Eventserver

``` 
You can return to the hub from any server using /hub.
We have a german community, but you can also join!
```
